private.toggle.label: Private generation
private.toggle.tip:
Private generation
Nothing you create is stored by the application: no prompt, no image, sound or video, no conversation history, no draft or remembered setting, no model usage count.
Results only exist for the length of the session: they are erased when you leave this mode, when you close the page, or after a period of inactivity.
Not covered: downloads you make yourself, your computer's memory and swap file, backups, screenshots. A deleted file is not irrecoverably erased on an SSD.
private.enter.title: Switch to private generation?
private.enter.message:
In this mode the application stores neither your prompts, nor your images, sounds or videos, nor the history, nor your drafts and settings. Results only live in the session, which is erased when you leave it, when you close the page, or after a period of inactivity (or when the application stops).

What this does not guarantee: a copy you save yourself, your computer's memory and swap file, its backups, screenshots, an irrecoverable erase of files on an SSD, and the text of a speech synthesis, which goes through the command line of the computing program (readable by the other programs of your session while it runs). The voice library is not available in this mode. The chat is private too: the conversation stays in this page (never stored, lost when you close it) and the chat's web search stays off until you turn it on (its queries leave the machine).
private.leave.title: Leave private generation?
private.leave.message: The private conversations and {0} result(s) will be erased for good. Save what you want to keep first.

private.erase.message: The private conversations and {0} result(s) will be erased for good. Private mode stays on, with an empty session.
